utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the book club’s been lively lately — lots of opinions, as usual. I can tell you who’s been showing up and what we’re reading next.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Oh? You’re sure about that? Tell me who’s been showing up, then.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — Mara, Jun, and Peter have been coming pretty regularly, and Lina popped in last week too. We’re reading "The Lantern House" next, if you can believe the pick.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, the book club sounds good — I’ll bring it up with the others and repeat the plan so everyone’s on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, great — thanks, Vik. I probably would’ve missed the details, so that helps a lot.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No problem — I’ll mention it again when I talk to the group so nobody misses it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what time and place is the book club meeting?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I think it’s at 7 on Thursday at the community center. I’ll confirm while I’m out and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks — just send me the update if it changes.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ve been meaning to ask—what book are you all reading for the club this month?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re reading *The Midnight Library* this month—if you want, I can loan you my copy.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’s very kind of you—I'd love to borrow it. When would be a good time to pick it up?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can make book club work as long as it doesn’t conflict with pickup time. What day were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thursday evenings seemed like a good fit—would that work around pickup time?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thursday could work if we keep it after pickup. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like to keep it simple—what’s the plan for the book club this week?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, simple is good—let’s just meet Thursday evening and chat about the first half of the book.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me—Thursday evening and the first half only. I’ll bring my notes and keep it short.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, Pia, I’m so glad I ran into you — the book club’s meeting soon, and you should absolutely come!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’d like to, but I need to know the time and where it’s being held first.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course — it’s this Thursday at 7 at my place, just a few houses down on Maple Street. I’d love to see you there!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve been hearing bits and pieces about the book club—sounds like I missed a lively one. What book are you all discussing?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: We’re reading "The Secret Garden" this month, Nell—there’s still plenty of room if you’d like to join us next time.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that sounds lovely—I’d be happy to come next time if you’ll have me.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let’s make sure we have the details right first—what book did the club choose, and when are we meeting?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m sorry, I don’t have the book club details yet—could you remind me what we picked and when we’re meeting?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I don’t have those details either, so I’d better not guess. Let’s check with the group chat or whoever organized it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m thinking I might sit this one out, but I hope the book club goes well.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Aw, fair enough — I’ll let the group know you’re rooting for us. If you change your mind, you can still join late.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane — I appreciate it. Maybe next time, if things are calmer.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mina—if the book club needs anything, I’ve got tools and tape to spare.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus. Do you know what book we’re discussing next?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’m not sure yet, but I can ask around and find out for you.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t pinned down the book club location yet, but I’m keeping track. If you want, I can check where we’re meeting next.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, please do—just let me know where and when.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll check and get back to you with the location and time.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Oh, I’ve got a few spare bookshelves and a folding table if the book club needs them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’s really kind of you, Gus. I’ll mention it to the group.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing—just let me know if you need me to bring them over.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to join, but could we pin down the time and where everyone’s meeting first?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Sure — do we have a set time and place yet, or should we pick one now?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Let’s pick one now — I’d feel better if we met at 7 at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, the book club's been lovely lately — a good mix of thoughtful takes and lively debate. I can ask around and see what everyone’s reading next if you’d like.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be great, Jules — thank you. I’d love to know what everyone’s reading next.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll ask around and see what everyone’s picking up next. I’ll let you know what I hear!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, the book club? I should check if we’ve got enough tea and biscuits for everyone before we meet.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m happy to help top things up if you need—I'll probably be a bit late, as usual.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’d be lovely, thanks—if you can grab tea and biscuits, I’ll make sure the list’s ready. I’ll save you a seat when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the book club? I heard they’re picking a new novel this week, and everyone’s got opinions already!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I know, school-night schedules make it tricky, but I’m curious what they choose. I just hope it’s something we can all get through without too much page-stress!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Same here — I’m hoping for something lively, not a doorstop. If they pick a page-turner, I’m in!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—just send me the book title and time, and I’ll see if I can make it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll text you the book title and time later today, and I’d love to see you there if you can make it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks Rosa — I’ll watch for your text and let you know if I can swing it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Leo — I’m happy to help with the book club. What do you need?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Could you send me the next meeting time and the book list?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll send you the next meeting time and the book list right away.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, Nell, you should absolutely come to book club this week — we’re picking our next read and it’d be fun to have you there.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that sounds lovely—I'd be happy to come and listen in. Just let me know when and where it is.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great — we meet Thursday at 7 in the community room by the library, and I’ll save you a seat.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can help keep track of where the book club’s meeting, if you tell me the location.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Opal. Let’s meet at the community center next Thursday at 7 PM.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — community center next Thursday at 7 PM. I’ll keep that noted.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are we still meeting at the library on Thursday, or did the book club move again?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m not sure yet — let me check the details before I say for certain.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — can you let me know as soon as you check?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, right — how’s the book club going these days?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, you know, it’s going all right — I keep forgetting the titles, but I’m enjoying it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Ha, that sounds about right. What’s the last one you read?
